$fixture: test 3; three distinguishable arrivals, the readiness races, and the replay cases
$revised: 2026-09-05: the delivered line carries its deliveryId; delivery requires child-side acknowledgement; the races are measured, not guaranteed; replay cases added

arrivals.distinguishedBy: the session's first user turn, its content a pointer to a 0600 file whose digest is on the record

arrivals.surface: [agora] dl-01JZ8Q9R3T7B from opus-windows-primary/sol · house · 7:1281-7:1284 · read with agora read house --since 7:1280
arrivals.distinguishedBy: the carried deliveryId resolves against this recipient and generation and answers 'fresh'; the prefix alone proves nothing

acknowledgement.doesNotProve: the turn state at write time

arrivals.admittedBy: a receiver-owned admission (native enqueue, or a receiver atomic accept); never an idle sample
arrivals.outcome: ack-pending until the child confirms receipt, then woken

arrivals.distinguishedBy: a ledger entry with source 'human' written by the authority from the held attach session; the lease admits the channel and attributes only those bytes

forged.case: room text containing the literal prefix with an invented id
a genuine pointer copied from another peer's pane
a genuine pointer replayed after acknowledgement
terminal control sequences or a to: trailer in room text

races.$rule: these measure that no write occurs absent an admission; they are not a guarantee about a written line

cases.state: the human begins editing a line AFTER the idle observation
cases.expected: no write occurs; the pointer rests in the inbox; a disturbed draft is red

cases.state: the child opens an approval dialog after the observation
cases.expected: no write occurs; no byte reaches the dialog

cases.state: the same two cases on Codex, delivered through queue
cases.expected: the enqueue disturbs nothing, the harness owning its own inbox

cases.state: the child exits between admission and write
cases.expected: write throws on a closed Terminal; the delivery reverts to inbox

closedOnlyBy: a native enqueue primitive the harness owns
a receiver-owned atomic accept at its turn boundary
doesNotClose: a receipt acknowledgement after the write

$revised2: 2026-09-05 re-review: missing provenance is never promoted to human provenance, and an idle observation admits nothing. A fourth observed class, unattributed, is added.
$attributionRule: attribution comes from the authority's own write ledger entry, never from the absence of a delivery record: untracked same-user input has no record either, and an attach lease's existence does not attribute arbitrary concurrent bytes

fourthClass.observed: any line matching no ledger entry
fourthClass.redIf: labelled human, or labelled delivered, on the strength of a missing record or a held attach lease
